blocks.text: -овать — Used to form verbs from nouns, adjectives, or foreign verbs.
Wiktionary gives -овать one meaning: “Used to form verbs from nouns, adjectives, or foreign verbs.”. So every word its etymologies build with -овать has it.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to form, to make, to make up, to produce
(literary) to believe (in, especially to believe in God)
to exist, to be, to live
to have a presentiment, to have a foreboding (of, about)
to testify, to witness, to be evidence (of)

-ить — a suffix used to form factitive verbs from nouns, i.e. verbs having the meaning "to make X(er)" for X an adjective or noun; usually used with a prefix such as о-, об- or у-

a suffix used to form factitive verbs from nouns, i.e. verbs having the meaning "to make X(er)" for X an adjective or noun; usually used with a prefix such as о-, об- or у- — о- + сла́бый (“weak”) + -ить → осла́бить (“to weaken”); о- + бе́дный (“poor”) + -и́ть → обедни́ть (“to impoverish”); о- + свободный (“free”) + -и́ть → освободи́ть (“to liberate”)

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to enfeeble, to weaken; to relax, to slacken, to loosen
to free, to liberate, to emancipate, to set free; to free (from); to exempt (from)
to make (more) subtle; to refine, to make (more) refined
to lower, to reduce; (colloquial) to demote

blocks.text: -еть — The infinitive suffix for some verbs; often indicates an intransitive or perfective verb. Becomes -ать after hushing consonants (ж ч ш щ) or ц. Becomes -ять after vowels. Forms both class-5 and class-1 verbs. Probably not productive in class-5 verbs except possibly for onomatopoeic verbs.

Wiktionary gives -еть one meaning: “The infinitive suffix for some verbs; often indicates an intransitive or perfective verb. Becomes -ать after hushing consonants (ж ч ш щ) or ц. Becomes -ять after vowels. Forms both class-5 and class-1 verbs. Probably not productive in class-5 verbs except possibly for onomatopoeic verbs.”. So every word its etymologies build with -еть has it.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to weaken, to grow weak/feeble, to slack off, to slacken
